in_sanskrit.name: Kv
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kv एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘Kr’ meaning ‘to do’ and ‘V’ meaning ‘God’. Represents the divine grace bestowed upon an individual. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with various deities including Krishna and Vishnu.
